## 🇬🇧 English

### 📝 Feature description
Describe clearly what you want to add or change in BepInExUpdater.

### 🎯 Problem it solves
What problem will this solve? What is inconvenient right now?

### ✨ Desired behavior
How should it work from the user's point of view?

### 🔀 Alternatives
Have you considered other ways to solve this problem?

### 📎 Additional context
Screenshots, links, examples from other programs — anything that helps understand the idea.
